## Escalate Case

Creates the Escalation with its ack clock, moves ownership toward the receiving role's on-duty member THROUGH Assign Owner (the single writer), and refuses a skip of more than one rung without override+note. It sits beside the service desk's Escalate Ticket: that moves a Ticket's priority; this owns the ladder. Automation is attributed (`raisedByPolicy`).

```ts
import EscalateCaseCommand from '@cardstack/catalog/cards/service-desk/commands/escalate-case-command';

await new EscalateCaseCommand(commandContext).execute(input);
```

### Non-goals

No notification to the receiving level; cards have no way to send one, so the Escalation's acknowledgement clock is the surface.
